description: Authenticates a sending domain for Cartero, a transactional email service backed by Twilio SendGrid, by adding SendGrid's three domain-authentication CNAME records (return path and two DKIM keys).
variableDescription: %mailid%: the numeric part of the SendGrid return-path host em<id>; %mailtarget%: its target (uNNNN.wlNNN.sendgrid.net); %dkim1target% / %dkim2target%: targets of the s1/s2 DKIM CNAMEs (sN.domainkey.uNNNN.wlNNN.sendgrid.net). All values come from the SendGrid domain-authentication API for the customer's domain.
